#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH -p leeburton-pool
#SBATCH --account=power-leeburton-users_v2
#SBATCH --qos=owner100d
#SBATCH --job-name=vasp_run_static-20261023-220710
#SBATCH --comment=bmd_attempt:c38297d4-3914-4540-ae3b-e45605c24670
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=24
#SBATCH --mem=128G
#SBATCH --output=/bmd-db/guest/logs/vasp_run_static-20261023-220710.slurm.out
#SBATCH --error=/bmd-db/guest/logs/vasp_run_static-20261023-220710.slurm.err
set -e -o pipefail

# -- module loads (compute node, verbose diagnostics enabled) --
if ! type module >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    source /etc/bashrc
fi
module purge
module load intel/rocky8-oneAPI-2023
module load vasp/rocky8-intel-6.4.1
echo "[sbatch debug] PATH=$PATH"
module list
which vasp_std
which mpirun

# -- reasonable stack size for VASP --
ulimit -s 81920 || true

# -- propagate environment expected by the runner --
export VASP_CMD='mpirun -n $SLURM_NTASKS vasp_std'
export JOBFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=/bmd-db/guest/jobflow_minimal.yaml
export PMG_VASP_PSP_DIR=/bmd-db/potcars
export CUSTODIAN_NO_GZIP=1
export ATOMATE2_VASP_ZIP_FILES=False

# -- POTCAR sanity (warn and show layout) --
echo "PMG_VASP_PSP_DIR=$PMG_VASP_PSP_DIR"
ls -ld "$PMG_VASP_PSP_DIR"/POT_* >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "[warn] No POT_* dir found under $PMG_VASP_PSP_DIR"

# -- runner body --
mkdir -p /bmd-db/guest/flows/vasp_run_static-20261023-220710
cd /bmd-db/guest/flows/vasp_run_static-20261023-220710
export BMD_SUBMISSION_ATTEMPT_ID=c38297d4-3914-4540-ae3b-e45605c24670
printf '%s\n' '[sbatch] Using partition=leeburton-pool account=power-leeburton-users_v2'
echo "[sbatch] VASP_CMD=$VASP_CMD"
echo "[sbatch] SLURM_NTASKS=${SLURM_NTASKS:-<unset>}"
which srun 2>/dev/null || true; srun --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true
which /bmd/bmdguest/envs/atomate2_remote/bin/python || true
/bmd/bmdguest/envs/atomate2_remote/bin/python --version
test -f /bmd-db/guest/flows/vasp_run_static-20261023-220710/run_job.py || { printf '%s\n' '[sbatch] Missing run_job.py at /bmd-db/guest/flows/vasp_run_static-20261023-220710/run_job.py'; exit 1; }
